content.short: Juicyway is a Nigerian payments platform with multi-currency accounts, FX and stablecoin-powered transfers.
content.description: Juicyway is a Nigerian payments platform that helps African businesses and individuals send, receive and hold foreign currency across borders. It offers multi-currency accounts, currency exchange at market rates, treasury and spend-management tools, payment links and APIs, and fast international transfers. Under the hood, Juicyway settles using stablecoins such as USDT and USDC alongside bank rails, and it has quietly processed more than a billion dollars in cross-border volume for thousands of businesses, including names like Bolt and Nigerian Breweries. It targets companies, creators and freelancers who need reliable global money movement without slow, costly bank wires.
content.meta: Juicyway offers multi-currency accounts, FX and stablecoin transfers in Africa. Discover Juicyway and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
